name: International Grid
description: The Swiss grid: square corners, content set on space rather than in boxes, each module headed by a heavy accent rule, rules as heavy 3px bars in the accent, ink outlines on controls, generous padding, short linear fades that never nudge, and the column grid on the shared surfaces.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's grid recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: A decorative gradient texture sits behind surfaces.

tokens.texture: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 18%, transparent) 0 1px, transparent 1px 64px)
